extended_forecast.scope: Best-match hourly point model forecasts; no official warning or exact onset eligibility

history_local.scope: One to seven daily reanalysis values (ERA5, ERA5-Land or ERA5-seamless) in Asia/Kolkata, with conservative five-day availability delay; a model returns only the variables it carries and an unsupported variable is refused by name

marine.scope: Modeled wave values at a provider-selected sea grid cell within 50 km of a named coastal place; not an official sea-area bulletin, named sea-area forecast, or navigation/fishing clearance

river.scope: Modeled GloFAS daily discharge at a provider-selected river cell; not an observed gauge level, danger threshold, inundation forecast or official flood warning
